name: open-items-tracker
description: Visualize, edit, and manage your open-items.md backlog inside VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and Antigravity IDE. Full CRUD for modules, sub-sections, and items; drag-to-reorder; inline editing; sort strategies; live file sync; and AI skill auto-install.

commands.title: Open Items Tracker: AI Skill Status & Install

enumDescriptions: By status: open → partial → future → done
Undone items first, done items last
openItemsTracker.defaultSort.description: Default sort order for items within each module.

openItemsTracker.collapseByDefault.description: Collapse all module accordions when the panel is opened.

openItemsTracker.showDoneItems.description: Show completed (done) items in the panel.

openItemsTracker.showFutureItems.description: Show future-phase items in the panel.

openItemsTracker.gitIntegration.description: Enable real-time Git status and modifications visualization for open-items.md.

openItemsTracker.gitHighlight.description: Highlight modified, added, and deleted items in the panel using Git diff status.

openItemsTracker.gitShowInlineDiff.description: Show inline word-level text differences (green/red highlights) inside modified items.

openItemsTracker.undoRedoStackSize.description: Maximum number of undo steps to retain in history.

openItemsTracker.promptSkillInstall.description: Show a one-time prompt to install the Open Items Tracker AI skill into your AI coding assistant (Claude Code or Antigravity IDE) when the extension activates.

openItemsTracker.skillPathClaudeCode.description: Override the target directory for the AI skill when running in VS Code (Claude Code). Leave empty to use the default: ~/.claude/skills/open-items-tracker/

openItemsTracker.skillPathAntigravity.description: Override the target directory for the AI skill when running in Antigravity IDE. Leave empty to use the default: ~/.gemini/config/skills/open-items-tracker/

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run lint
